mechanism: Nalmefene is metabolized by CYP3A4 and dronedarone is a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, potentially increasing nalmefene exposure; additionally, both agents may have additive effects on cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor for increased nalmefene adverse effects (nausea, headache) and cardiac rhythm; consider nalmefene dose reduction if co-administration is necessary and ensure appropriate cardiac monitoring.
